name: Harness by Autonomous
description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents across your laptop, servers and GPU boxes from one end-to-end encrypted command center and CLI.

skills.name: Remote Sessions
skills.description: Starts a coding-agent session on any linked machine and folder with harness new, running it in a daemon-owned tmux pane.

skills.name: Cross-Harness Coordination
skills.description: Lets Claude Code and Codex start, wait for, and read other harnesses through the harness skill and its CLI verbs.

skills.name: Daemon MCP Server
skills.description: Serves the paired daemon's tools as a stdio MCP server to list harnesses, read open questions, and send prompts.

skills.name: Encrypted Machine Links
skills.description: Connects your machines over direct WebRTC, Cloudflare TURN, or a keyless relay, with every path sealed end to end.

skills.name: Domain Harnesses
skills.description: Installs Store harnesses that give a coding agent a craft's instructions, toolchain and live viewer, such as Blender or KiCad.
